dialogues.speaker: Three Strategies Scroll
dialogues.text: "Supposedly this is a sword-training formation used by the tengu of Inazuma to teach their students. I can't really make sense of it myself. It looks more like some kind of strange trick meant to fool the eyes."

dialogues.speaker: Three Strategies Scroll
dialogues.text: "There's also a name carved into it: 'Teruyo.' Okikuni says he's never heard of a tengu by that name, so it's probably just someone's random carving."
